owner: Explicit owner continuation of native socket ownership, safe retry and pending IO review

native_close.success: Release exact native record; retain completion owners until IO drain
native_close.would_block: Retain exact native descriptor; retry with ordinary linger-off policy; never retry after success
native_close.other_errors: Sticky uncertain quarantine; no subsequent numeric-handle access; cleanup failure retains Application and worker image lease
native_close.option_failure: Keep retained ownership without closing; invalid/not-initialized descriptor becomes uncertain
native_close.preconditions: Exclusive first-party socket ownership and a live balanced Winsock scope

deferred_capacity: validated session cap + 8, allocated before first-party socket acquisition
client_ownership: Strong until native close and read/write/timer completions retire; no strong back-reference to Impl
